source_cut_definition: Smallest set of failed ultimate roots that leaves fewer than three pairwise root-disjoint eligible witnesses.
preservation: Append root compromise and frozen-promotion events rather than deleting prior observations.
limitations: Declared ancestry is not proof of authenticated source identity
Hash chain checked in-memory, not transactional durable storage
Four-root cut result depends on modeled graph and threshold
